narrative.overview: Vocalicious is crafted as a high-precision, zero-noise culinary terminal tailored for Vietnamese food culture. It abandons visual clutter, noisy promotional banners, and convoluted multi-page navigations in favor of purposeful dark ergonomics, instant auditory feedback, and fluid voice recognition.

rules.name: The Zero Noise Rule
rules.body: Never introduce flashing marketing banners, intrusive discount pop-ups, or unprompted modals. The primary accent is reserved strictly for user intent, voice feedback, and transactional certainty.

rules.name: The Currency Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Prices are always set in bold or extrabold with the localized Vietnamese đ or VNĐ symbol clearly visible.

rules.name: The State-Driven Elevation Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat with 1px border contrast. Elevation and glowing halos only activate in direct response to user state.

dos: Do maintain a strict 48x48dp minimum touch target for all clickable buttons, chips, and icons.
Do preserve the 1px hairline border (border-slate-800) on dark card surfaces.
Do use Culinary Gold (#f59e0b) exclusively for user-initiated primary actions and voice cues.
Do show transparent preparation time badges on dishes and precise ETD countdowns.
donts: Don't add unrequested commercial pop-ups, flashing discount tickers, or visual noise.
Don't use generic non-Vietnamese food photos.
Don't drop below 4.5:1 text contrast ratio on dark backgrounds.
Don't hijack or alter the physical Back button or system gesture behavior.
